frames.frame: ^%name%^! Rise and shine! Your father and I have a surprise waiting for you downstairs.
A surprise? Is it... is it a curio?!
Not just any curio, @son/daughter@. This is ^Ducan^. He has been with our family for a long time, and now he is yours.
He's amazing! Wait... why are there suitcases by the door?
Sweetie, there is something we should have told you a long time ago. We weren't always just your parents...
This is the ^Galactic Legion^! Step out of the house with your hands where we can see them!
%name%, listen to me! Take Ducan and go! Find the ^Hermit^ at the old dock. Don't trust the Legion!
Mom! Dad! ...They're gone. They took them away.
Chin up, kid. Your parents are no criminals, whatever the Legion says. Cross the island and meet me at the dock, and train that Ducan along the way. You are going to need him.
Whoa, easy there! Ever since the Legion landed, wild curios have been running all over the island.
Tap one of your curio's skills to attack. Stronger skills cost ^mana^ and need a few turns to recharge. Let's see what that Ducan can do!
Now that's a curio trainer! Wild curios you defeat sometimes want to ^join your team^. Keep battling and your collection will grow.
Hey, I know you! You're the kid whose parents got hauled off by the Legion. Nobody crosses my bridge without a battle!
My parents didn't do anything wrong! Let's go, Ducan!
Okay, okay! You win. The bridge is all yours... and hey, sorry about your folks.
Shhh! The birds in the old treehouse are nesting, and their curios get grumpy when strangers climb up.
I just need to get to the other side of the island.
Then you'll have to get past them first. Good luck!
This generator powers the whole island, and the Legion put me in charge of guarding it. Turn around!
The Legion put you in charge? Then you know where they took my parents!
Even if I did, I wouldn't tell a fugitive's kid. Curios, attack!
Arr! This be where the treasure's buried, and it be OURS! Scram, landlubber!
Pirates? On our island? Ducan, looks like we're digging for treasure today!
Captain! The @boy/girl@ from the beach is here, and @he/she@ brought that pesky Ducan!
So you're the little runaway everyone is talking about. You want a boat? You'll have to take mine!
Blast it! Fine, take the ship. But you haven't seen the last of me!
Well fought, %name%. I saw the Legion's ship heading out across the ^Open Sea^. That pirate boat will get us there.
Hold on, Mom and Dad. We're coming!
The Open Sea is full of [water] curios. [electric] skills hit them hard, but they will wash away any [fire] curio you bring.
Watch for the ^Strong^ and ^Weak^ markers during battle and choose your curios wisely.
Captain's orders: sink anyone who follows the Legion ship! ...Wait, what is that thing rising out of the water?!
That's... a SEA MONSTER!
Ugh... it's dark, it's slimy and it smells like old fish. We got swallowed by the sea monster!
Don't panic! Beat the curios living in here and this big fella will spit us right back out.
Brrr! An iceberg in the tropics? Something is messing with the weather out here, %name%.
Surprised? My weather machine will drown every island from here to the horizon, and the Legion pays me handsomely for it!
You're working for the Legion?! Ducan, let's shut this machine down!
Captain Blackfin, you failed. The prisoners have already been moved beyond the storm. Retreat!
They're getting away again...
Not for long. The sky is clearing and the way ahead is open. Rest up, %name%. The real journey starts now.
Don't give up! Level up your curios, rank up their skills in the skill tree and try again.
